large_file_detection.rationale: No git hooks, CI size check, LFS, or ESLint max-lines rule.

tech_debt_tracking.rationale: No TODO/FIXME scanner, linter fixme rule, or code quality platform.

vcs_cli_tools.rationale: gh is installed and authenticated as factory-riya-bhivare.

automated_pr_review.rationale: Last 10 PRs: the only review is by a human (factory-riya-bhivare). No bot-generated review comments.

agentic_development.rationale: Recent commits carry Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] trailers.

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: Merged PRs #1 and #9: the CI check took about 20s and 17s.

build_performance_tracking.rationale: Only setup-node pnpm dependency caching. No build cache, metrics, or timing analysis.

deployment_frequency.rationale: No releases or deploy workflows in GitHub. Deploys happen outside the repo (Conjure via Factory automation), and the repo is one day old.

progressive_rollout.rationale: Skipped: not an infra repo (static site).

rollback_automation.rationale: Skipped: not an infra repo (static site).

release_automation.rationale: No CD pipeline in the repo. AGENTS.md documents a manual `pnpm deploy:conjure`. The auto-deploy is an external Factory automation, not repo config.

agents_md.rationale: AGENTS.md (3.4 KB) covers layout, commands, conventions, and deploy.

readme.rationale: README.md has a description, setup, and commands.

automated_doc_generation.rationale: No doc generation tooling or workflow.

documentation_freshness.rationale: README.md and AGENTS.md changed within 180 days (1df34e5).

service_flow_documented.rationale: README documents the external Open-Meteo API dependency and the verdict data flow.

agents_md_validation.rationale: CI runs the same commands but nothing explicitly validates AGENTS.md.

env_template.rationale: No env vars needed. README and AGENTS.md state no backend and no API key.

local_services_setup.rationale: Skipped: no local service dependencies (public Open-Meteo API only).

devcontainer_runnable.rationale: Skipped: no devcontainer, and no devcontainer CLI.

runbooks_documented.rationale: No runbook or incident-response pointers. Only the deploy steps in AGENTS.md.

branch_protection.rationale: Admin access. Rulesets return [] and the branches API shows main protected:false.

secret_scanning.rationale: Skipped: the secret-scanning API returns 403 for this integration token, and no gitleaks/trufflehog/pre-commit scanning was found.

automated_security_review.rationale: Skipped: the code-scanning API returns 403 for this token, and no other security report tooling was found.

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: .gitignore covers .env, node_modules, dist, .DS_Store, but not IDE configs (.idea, .vscode).

privacy_compliance.rationale: Skipped: a static site with no end-user data collection.

secrets_management.rationale: .env is gitignored, but there is no .env.example and no secrets manager pattern. Ambiguous, so it fails.

issue_labeling_system.rationale: Type labels exist (bug, enhancement), but there are no priority or area labels.

backlog_health.rationale: 7 open issues, all with descriptive titles and 2 labels each. None older than 365 days.

type_check.rationale: tsconfig.json with strict: true, and `pnpm typecheck` runs tsc.

formatter.rationale: No Prettier or other formatter config.

pre_commit_hooks.rationale: No husky, lint-staged, or pre-commit hooks.

naming_consistency.rationale: AGENTS.md documents the naming conventions (camelCase, PascalCase, UPPER_CASE, kebab-case files).

dead_code_detection.rationale: tsconfig noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters, plus typescript-eslint no-unused-vars, flag unused code.

code_modularization.rationale: Skipped: a small single-page project where module boundaries are not meaningful.

heavy_dependency_detection.rationale: A Vite-bundled app with no bundle analyzer or size-limit.

integration_tests_exist.rationale: No Playwright, Cypress, or integration test directory.

unit_tests_runnable.rationale: `npx --no-install vitest list` exited 0 and listed 25 tests without running them.

test_performance_tracking.rationale: No test timing reporting or analytics.

flaky_test_detection.rationale: No retry config or flaky tracking. No duplicate check names in PR rollups.

test_naming_conventions.rationale: AGENTS.md documents that `src/*.test.ts` tests sit next to the code they test.

test_isolation.rationale: Vitest runs files in parallel by default. No --runInBand or single-thread override.

interactive_qa_exists.rationale: README: pnpm install, pnpm dev at localhost:5173, pick an airport and times, read the card. No auth or services.

interactive_qa_runnable.rationale: Confirmed this session: the dev server ran and ORD with 5h was exercised with screenshots taken.

api_schema_docs.rationale: Skipped: a static site with no HTTP API.

structured_logging.rationale: No logging library or logger module.

distributed_tracing.rationale: No trace or request ID propagation.

code_quality_metrics.rationale: Skipped: the code-scanning API returns 403 for this token, and there is no coverage config or quality bot.

deployment_observability.rationale: No dashboards or deploy notifications referenced.

health_checks.rationale: A deployed static site with no health check mechanism.

circuit_breakers.rationale: The Open-Meteo call has a failure fallback message but no retry, backoff, or breaker.

profiling_instrumentation.rationale: Skipped: profiling is not meaningful for this small static site.
